# Domain contract: delivery

- **API version:** `delivery.markitect.org/v1alpha1`
- **Definition source:** `domains/delivery.yaml`

## Normalized schema and policy

```yaml
apiVersion: delivery.markitect.org/v1alpha1
kinds:
    Release:
        required:
            - sourceRevision
            - policy
            - evidence
        properties:
            evidence:
                type: array
                items:
                    type: ref
                    refKind: ReleaseEvidence
            policy:
                type: ref
                refKind: ReleasePolicy
            sourceRevision:
                type: string
    ReleaseEvidence:
        required:
            - sourceRevision
            - check
            - result
        properties:
            check:
                type: string
            result:
                type: string
                enum:
                    - passed
                    - failed
            sourceRevision:
                type: string
    ReleasePolicy:
        required:
            - requiredChecks
        properties:
            channel:
                type: string
                enum:
                    - stable
                    - preview
            requiredChecks:
                type: array
                items:
                    type: string
relations:
    governedBy:
        description: Desired release policy used by a release record.
        field: policy
        sourceKinds:
            - Release
        targetKinds:
            - ReleasePolicy
        context: true
        invalidate: true
    hasEvidence:
        description: Immutable observed check evidence for a desired release.
        field: evidence
        sourceKinds:
            - Release
        targetKinds:
            - ReleaseEvidence
        context: true
        invalidate: true
constraints:
    - name: release-evidence-must-pass
      description: A recorded check result must be passing; evidence remains distinct from the requested release state.
      select:
        kind: ReleaseEvidence
      assert:
        op: allowed
        field: result
        values:
            - passed
    - name: release-has-evidence
      description: A release observation is incomplete until at least one check result is recorded.
      select:
        kind: Release
      assert:
        op: count
        scope: selection
        relation: hasEvidence
        min: 1
```
